events.fact: Xero OAuth app creation path: Log in to the Xero Developer Portal (developer.xero.com), navigate to My Apps, and click New App. Enter name, company URL, privacy policy URL, and redirect URI(s).
Xero permits up to 50 redirect URIs per app and requires absolute URIs (no wildcards). http://localhost is allowed for local development, while HTTPS is required for production.

Xero OAuth 2.0 endpoints confirmed via discovery: Authorization endpoint is https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize, token endpoint is https://identity.xero.com/identity/connect/token, and PKCE (S256) is supported.
Xero access tokens expire in 30 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 60 days of inactivity (or a 30-minute grace period if a refresh request times out/fails).

Xero developer pricing (effective March 2, 2026) uses a tiered model based on active connection limits and data egress: Starter (5 connections, free), Core (50 connections), Plus (1,000 connections), Advanced (10,000 connections), and Enterprise.
Xero AI data use policy: Data obtained from Xero's APIs may NOT be used to train AI/ML models.

Xero scope transition (March 2026): Xero transitioned from broad scopes (such as accounting.transactions) to granular scopes (such as accounting.invoices, accounting.payments). Apps created on or after March 2, 2026 use granular scopes immediately; older apps have until September 2027 to migrate.

Xero app certification and App Store listing require onboarding at least 10 active customer connections (using the integration within the last 30 days) and holding a paid developer plan, plus passing security assessments.
